Application Data.NAME: StitchWorks Embroidery Co.
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Stitched Lane, Suite 101, Embroidery City, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: StitchWorks Embroidery Co. specializes in custom embroidery and apparel production, providing high-quality embroidered goods for businesses and individuals. Our services include screen printing and heat transfer applications, with a strong focus on meeting customer specifications and deadlines. We do not engage in alterations, personal services, or the use of imported textile materials from high-risk regions. Our operations are strictly limited to embroidery and custom apparel without any cosmetic or personal enhancement services. We prioritize safety and compliance, employing well-maintained equipment and fire prevention measures to mitigate operational risks.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2022, a heat press malfunction caused a minor fire resulting in damage to the embroidery workstation. The estimated repair cost was $1,500. The incident has been resolved, and all equipment has been replaced or repaired. No claims were filed, and the business continued operations without interruption.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: B Rate Class: IX, Grade: B, Label: UL Listed, with a capacity of 1,000 lbs.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter of the premises, along with 24-hour surveillance monitored by a local security service, and monthly inspections conducted by a certified safety officer.
